bio: Meet Sunny. Years behind the chair and thousands of fades later, he packed the whole shop into a kit and took it mobile across Ubud. Classic barbering, clean lines, and a finish that actually holds.
His thing is the details: fades that blend seamless, beards mapped to your face, and a hot-towel shave that feels like a proper ritual. One client at a time, full focus, and the chair comes to you.

services.name: Haircut
services.description: Consultation, cut and style with premium products. Finished with a complimentary hot-lather neck shave.

services.name: Beard Trim
services.description: Shape-up, straight-razor edging and a hot & cold towel combo, finished with beard oil or balm.

services.name: Haircut & Beard
services.description: The full reset. Everything in the haircut, plus a complete beard sculpt, fresh head to chin.

services.name: Hot Towel Shave
services.description: Pre-shave oil, hot-towel steam and a close straight-razor shave, sealed with a cooling tonic.
